# QnALog 1.6.2

## Highlights

- List Bailian transcription models from the platform catalogue and route recognized model families through their matching HTTP or WebSocket APIs.
- Support whole-file Bailian transcription for recordings and imported audio, plus model-specific realtime protocols on desktop.
- Reduce catalogue requests by requesting up to 100 models per page while still requiring a complete result.

## User impact

This release does not change the settings schema or API key storage. Existing provider settings and keys remain in place. Quick-config defaults are unchanged. Selecting a recognized Bailian model updates its model, endpoint, and protocol together. Bailian WebSocket recording requires desktop Obsidian; HTTP transcription remains available on mobile where supported. No existing feature is removed.
